summary.intent: Implement trail #355: prune the repo's scripts and justfile recipes down to those with a real caller (CI, weekly workflow, a recipe, or a recurring doc), and record one-off measurements in docs instead of committed scripts.
summary.outcome: A subagent implemented the cleanup and pushed it as draft PR #431 (8 signed commits, 41 files, +57/-3,799): 16 of 33 script files deleted, 8 trimmed, recipes cut from 37 to 30, a new AGENTS.md 'Scripts' rule and a docs section added. The PR body was then rewritten via `gh pr edit 431 --body-file`; CI was not polled and several paths were not run.

repo: Script retention rule: a script stays only if a CI job, the weekly workflow, a justfile recipe, or a documented recurring task calls it; one-off measurements are recorded in docs (method and results), not kept as scripts.

weekly.py is the hub of the weekly workflow: it imports agent_eval.py (weekly.py:30) and calls corpora.py, headline.py, oracle_data.py, rdt.mjs and rdg.mjs; schema_version.py is used by weekly, agent_eval and a Rust test.

Script callers: bench.py via `just bench` (the local replacement for the removed PR gate 82530df7), gate_fixtures.mjs via `just gate-measure`, verify-install.sh via the CI Install job, check-packaging.mjs via `just lint`, napi-loader-version.mjs via `build:napi`, test_*.py via `just test-py`.

main is currently red: `just lint` exits 101 because crates/core/tests/semantic_join.rs is missing fields from #426/#427 (trail #354, fixed by #429). It is the only clippy error but it halts the recipe, so later lint steps must be run separately.

Removing the oracle reference/layer-only scripts required trimming related TypeScript, tests, the OUTCOMES list, vocabulary.json, and dead propMap/listedProps in canonical.ts; resolver/ambient.rs only had comments edited.
oxfmt --check flags 3 oracle JSON files (including the regenerated vocabulary.json); these are outside the lint globs.
Pre-existing actionlint SC2086 info at .github/workflows/weekly.yml:91, not touched by this PR.

code.finding: Imports agent_eval, which is why agent_eval.py and agent_questions.json were kept despite having no other caller.
Existing actionlint SC2086 (unquoted variable) info; pre-existing and left alone.
Missing fields from #426/#427 break clippy on main (exit 101); tracked as trail #354, fixed by #429.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user messages; the PR body here was built from the subagent's report and should be treated as claims it made, not independently verified results.
Judging gates by exit code and running later steps separately when an early recipe step fails (just lint) gives useful coverage despite a red main.
Writing the PR body to a temp file and using `gh pr edit --body-file` avoids shell-quoting problems with long markdown bodies.

friction: Known main breakage (semantic_join.rs) makes `just lint` fail before later steps, forcing manual separate runs.
oxfmt flags generated JSON (vocabulary.json) that sits outside lint globs, an inconsistency.
Merge with #428 was anticipated but unnecessary since origin/main was unchanged.
open_items: CI on PR #431 has not been polled; the PR is still a draft.
Not run: `just test`, `just coverage`, full oracle oxlint test-files pass, and the gate-measure, bench, verify-install and weekly code paths.
setup, install-tools and build recipes were kept though they have no doc callers; may be worth revisiting.
Main's lint break depends on #429 landing before `just lint` can be green.
